name: XBrickMap
definition: A method that improves on skipping through multiple grid levels by using tiled bitmasks to perform hierarchical skips (4³, 2³, 1³ cuboids) via bitwise tests to identify empty voxel sections. Bitmasks also omit empty bricks within sectors via left-packing for memory savings.
summary: XBrickMap is a ray traversal algorithm using 4³ occupancy bitmasks to skip empty regions in hierarchical voxel grids, distinguished by compacted bitmasks for random access and support for arbitrary in-place edits.
